payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 1:1–9 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a sanctified assembly is called and sustained. Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes, God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
